failed_functional.reasoning: Normal logout revoked only its own session. End all sessions revoked the other Ruth session, but the initiating session still received 200 protected reads after refresh.

Courtyard exact retries were successful and stable, and Partial approval retries later handled reversed order and mismatches correctly. The mandatory Partial approval retry/mismatch sequence was not captured before publication, so the required checkpoint is missing.

Staff reads showed identified participation without option associations, and later Member views were private. The required immediate protected Leila read after Owen’s vote and before Leila’s Courtyard vote was not retained as a complete checkpoint.

Verifier was edited/opened and post-open editing was refused, but the first edit changed the limit unexpectedly and a corrective second edit made the final revision 4 instead of the required edit/open revisions 2/3.

Later Member reads correctly exposed only each Member’s own participation and staff reads exposed aggregate turnout, but the required immediate Owen-only read before Leila’s Courtyard vote was not captured.

Final audit data had readable actor/action/record/time entries, no choice associations, and no visible replay/rejection entries; however the original Shared-space publish exchange was not captured before acting, leaving required lifecycle evidence incomplete.

The second restart preserved active Ruth, Leila, and Owen sessions and all accepted receipts, but existing sessions were not retained for a first-restart survival check, so the two-restart requirement is incomplete.

The stale roster pause correctly returned 409 and the current pause succeeded, but Roster includes Owen was created after Owen was paused and therefore captured only Leila; the required both-member snapshot chain failed.

Refusal rehearsal stale and premature-publish receipts replayed identically before and after lifecycle changes and after restarts, but the required separately captured unchanged-state comparisons after each restart replay are incomplete.

Owen activation returned HTML without changing the roster. Verifier and Future snapshots therefore captured only Leila, not the required two-member Future snapshot.
